Weather summary: today northwestern edge of weakening High over Baltic Sea, at night moving from Scandinavia to Sea trough of Low and leaving by day eastwards.
Northern Baltic: southerly, in morning veering to westerly 4-10 m/s. From night isolated showers. Visibility from good to moderate.
Western Gulf of Finland, Northern Gulf of Riga, Vainameri: southerly 3-9 m/s, after midday veering gradually to westerly. Dry, tomorrow by day isolated showers. At night fog locally, otherwise visibility from good to moderate.
Eastern Gulf of Finland: variable 1-6 m/s, after midnight mainly southerly 3-9 m/s. Dry. At night fog locally, otherwise visibility from good to moderate.
